import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import gseapy

base='/workspace/inputs'
counts=pd.read_csv(base+'/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout=pd.read_csv(base+'/sample_layout.csv')
# map count matrix columns to layout SampleID's 3-1/9-1 style, using underscore in count columns
layout['count_col']=layout['SampleID'].str.replace('-','_',regex=False)
keep=layout['Group'].isin(['DMSO','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50'])
lay=layout.loc[keep].copy()
lay['condition']=lay['Group'].map({'DMSO':'DMSO','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50':'CBD_cisplatin'})
# pydeseq2 samples x genes
cts=counts[lay['count_col'].tolist()].T
cts.index=lay['SampleID'].tolist()
# ensure integer and remove all-zero genes
cts=cts.loc[:,cts.sum(axis=0)>0].astype(int)
meta=lay.set_index('SampleID')[['condition']]
print('counts',cts.shape,'meta',meta,sep='\\n')
print('library',cts.sum(axis=1).to_dict())
# Keep group order and explicit control reference in contrast.
dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=cts, metadata=meta, design_factors='condition', refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=2)
dds.deseq2()
stat=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','CBD_cisplatin','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, cooks_filter=True, independent_filter=True)
stat.summary()
res=stat.results_df.copy()
print('res shape',res.shape)
print(res.head())
# mapping
m=pd.read_csv(base+'/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv',sep='\\t')
gmap=dict(zip(m.ENSG,m.gene_name))
res['gene_name']=[gmap.get(g) for g in res.index]
res['padj']=res['padj'].astype(float)
res['log2FoldChange']=res['log2FoldChange'].astype(float)
deg=res[(res.padj<0.05)&(res.log2FoldChange.abs()>=0.5)&res.gene_name.notna()].copy()
print('DEGs',len(deg),'unique symbols',deg.gene_name.nunique())
print('DEGs target-related')
lib=gseapy.get_library(name='Reactome_2022',organism='Human')
target=[k for k in lib if k.startswith('TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes')][0]
path=set(lib[target])
print('path',target,'n',len(path))
print(deg[deg.gene_name.isin(path)][['gene_name','baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].sort_values('gene_name').to_string(index=False))
print('overlap',deg.gene_name.isin(path).sum(), '/',len(path),'unique overlap',len(set(deg.gene_name)&path))
# print all DEG names count
print('top degs')
print(deg.sort_values('padj')[['gene_name','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY
python /workspace/run_pydeseq2.py"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import gseapy
base='/workspace/inputs'
c=pd.read_csv(base+'/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
lay=pd.read_csv(base+'/sample_layout.csv'); lay['col']=lay.SampleID.str.replace('-','_',regex=False)
ctl=lay.loc[lay.Group=='DMSO','col']; trt=lay.loc[lay.Group=='Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','col']
cc=c[list(ctl)+list(trt)]
m=pd.read_csv(base+'/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv',sep='\\t'); gene=dict(zip(m.ENSG,m.gene_name))
lib=gseapy.get_library(name='Reactome_2022', organism='Human'); path=set(lib[[k for k in lib if k.startswith('TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes')][0]])
# DESeq2 ratios using outputs saved? rerun not. approximate methods.
def result(name, lfc, p, basefilter=None):
 p=np.asarray(p,float); lfc=np.asarray(lfc,float)
 q=np.full(len(p),np.nan); ok=np.isfinite(p)
 q[ok]=multipletests(p[ok],method='fdr_bh')[1]
 # For DESeq2-like filtering just all tested with nonzero total
 ok2=ok & (q<.05) & (np.abs(lfc)>=.5)
 syms=[gene.get(x) for x in cc.index[ok2]]
 ov=sorted(set(s for s in syms if s in path))
 print(name,'DEGs',sum(ok2),'overlap',len(ov),'/',len(path),ov)
 # print target status
 for x in path:
  ix=[i for i,g in enumerate(syms) if g==x]
 # target p q
 print(pd.DataFrame({'id':cc.index,'gene':[gene.get(x) for x in cc.index],'lfc':lfc,'p':p,'q':q}) .query('gene in @path').sort_values('gene').to_string(index=False))

# cpm normalized
libsize=cc.sum(axis=0).values
norm=cc.values/libsize*1e6
for transform in ['logcpm','lognorm','vst?']:
 if transform=='logcpm': z=np.log2(norm+0.5)
 elif transform=='lognorm': z=np.log2(norm+1)
 else: continue
 # Welch t
 t,p=stats.ttest_ind(z[:,:3],z[:,3:],axis=1,equal_var=False,nan_policy='omit')
 lfc=z[:,3:].mean(1)-z[:,:3].mean(1)
 result(transform,lfc,p)
 # student equal variance
 t,p=stats.ttest_ind(z[:,:3],z[:,3:],axis=1,equal_var=True,nan_policy='omit')
 result(transform+' equal',lfc,p)
# raw counts unnormalized t test maybe
for trans,z in [('raw',cc.values),('lograw',np.log2(cc.values+1))]:
 t,p=stats.ttest_ind(z[:,:3],z[:,3:],axis=1,equal_var=False,nan_policy='omit')
 lfc=z[:,3:].mean(1)-z[:,:3].mean(1)
 # raw diff not log, calculate proper mean normalized log fold
 if trans=='raw': lfc=np.log2((norm[:,3:].mean(1)+.5)/(norm[:,:3].mean(1)+.5))
 result(trans,lfc,p)
